description: While rooted in the real-world car subculture of touge racing, the aesthetic's modern form is inextricably linked to the manga and anime series Initial D , which served as its foundational text. The Touge aesthetic blends the fictional world of the anime with the real-world car culture it depicts, creating a nostalgic and highly stylized vision of speed and precision.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Speed, precision, nostalgia, escapism, driver skill, rebellious freedom

visualDNA.colour: Dark blues and blacks of the night, contrasted with the bright white/yellow of headlights and colorful car liveries
